The prose now gives more explanation of examples, definitions and the philosophical role of the results. A5 adds Skipper's relevant refinement critique and corrects the Holguín reference. A6 adopts Claude's two optional clarifications and explicitly limits the Bjorn comparison to a normal situation. A4's argument remains unchanged. The formal statements, equations and proof text are preserved.

The reports incorporate Claude's corrected environment and reviewer-persona descriptions and identify the work performed in the current pass. They are the paired anonymized reports for these versions. Internal run logs and human-input histories are not part of this package.

A5's published Good Guesses version comparison remains open; its author draft was checked. A4's significance remains less secure relative to Halpern and Wysocki. The final assessment describes the precise limits. E3 remains withdrawn. No contest submission has been made, and no review by the additional providers proposed by the operator is claimed.
